details.note: Intentional PEP 810 change documented in NEWS. The type change is the verified compatibility finding.

details.before: subscript raises KeyError, .keys() returns dict_keys, .items() returns dict_items
details.after: subscript raises TypeError, .keys() and .items() raise AttributeError
details.note: Dict-specific methods are no longer available. This is the intended behavioral change per PEP 810.
Set operations now work as expected on sys.lazy_modules
